we haven't lived in the same town since twenty-two, but my spare room is still basically yours. having a best friend in another city just means half your life is permanently parked by their kettle. send this to the one who still calls you from the supermarket aisle to ask which pasta you used to buy. #friendshipquotes #bestfriendquotes #longdistancefriendship
